profile_text.body:
OctoAI is listed as a for-profit startup founded in 2019, headquartered in Seattle, Washington, USA, with octo.ai as its website. The text gathered from that site does not describe OctoAI's own business. It reads as NVIDIA corporate material, covering GPUs and accelerated computing, NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, NeMo Switchyard, RTX and GeForce RTX 50 Series hardware, the Jetson and Isaac platforms, and a note that Deci was acquired by NVIDIA Corporation of Santa Clara, CA in May 2024 and dissolved as a separate corporate entity.

The profile holds no tracked products and no MCP servers for OctoAI, and no litigation cases. Washington state appears as a law exposure jurisdiction with a count of 114.
